generalization_guard: Same formula for all queries; no query-type/ID/label inputs; grid fixed a priori; held-out queries never touched.
hypothesis: Keeping the 0-4 LLM score and adding a smooth retrieval-rank prior keeps more of the top50 gain than rank-only RRF while protecting strong retrieval matches.
inputs: Cached llm-score-dev100 responses (one pass, 100 dev queries); no reranker calls.
labels: shared-labels/labels.json; unjudged top10 pairs graded by the frozen judge (human overrides preserved) before scoring.

qualifies_if.consistency: nDCG delta vs reference > 0 on both the pilot20 and new80 subsets
qualifies_if.ndcg@10_delta_vs_reference: > the reference's run-to-run MDD (0.009) with paired 95% CI lower bound > 0

rule: blended = LLM score + beta*(c+1)/(c+retrieval rank) over the top50; ties keep retrieval order; ranks 51-100 unchanged.
selection: Among qualifiers, highest all-100 nDCG@10; 3 configs on dev, so the winner's gain is optimistic. Report all configs.
